observations: Photo 0: Top-loading washing machine with lid open, showing drum and central agitator. Control panel visible on top. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HOME AFFAIRS'.

Photo 1: Front view of the same machine with lid closed. Control panel shows five knobs and labels: 'WASH-WATER TEMPERATURE', 'CYCLE WASH', 'SPIN SPEED', 'WASH-WATER LEVEL', and a large dial for 'WASH CYCLE'. Text below knobs: 'Commercial Rating 10.5kg Capacity 15 Cycles Water Level Control'. Brand name 'Avalanche' visible on left of panel.
Photo 2: Side-front angle of the machine, showing the same control panel and white casing. No visible damage or wear from this angle.
All photos show the machine outdoors on a concrete surface, with other appliances in the background.

claims.claim: Pure white & for commercial & domestic use
claims.evidence: Photo 1 and 2 show the machine is white. Photo 1 control panel states 'Commercial Rating', supporting commercial use. Domestic use is implied by design and common use of such machines.

Photo 1 control panel says '10.5kg Capacity', which supports the 10kg claim. However, 'industrial' is not confirmed by any label or feature visible in photos. The machine appears to be a commercial-grade top-loader, not heavy-duty industrial.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., motor, drum, or electrical issues)
risks.proof: Video of the machine running through a full cycle, including water filling, agitation, and spin.

risks.risk: Hidden wear or damage not visible in photos (e.g., rust inside drum, cracked agitator, or worn belts)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the drum interior, agitator, and underside of the machine.

risks.risk: Not actually 10.5kg capacity or mislabeled as commercial-grade
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's rating plate or serial number label, if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower capacity or domestic model

proof_requests: Video of the machine running through a full wash cycle.
Close-up photo of the drum interior and agitator.
Photo of the machine's rating plate or serial number label.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as an Avalanche top-loading washing machine with 10.5kg capacity, but its functionality and condition cannot be confirmed from photos alone. Hidden risks such as internal damage or non-functionality require proof before pricing. The 'industrial' claim is unverified and may affect value.
